newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Telesp's 1997 target price raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telesp's 1997 target price raised.

text.p: -- ING Barings said it has increased its year-end target on Brazil's Telesp to $285 from $260 per lot of 1,000 shares, giving the stock a potential increase of 24 percent in 1997.

-- It said in a report Telesp, the unit of federal Telebras system serving Sao Paulo state, has "strong growth prospects due to its low telephone penetration and a rising operating margin, and is expected to see an average annual growth rate of 25 percent over the next five years."

-- It also said that if Telesp is the first of Telebras' local subsidiaries to be privatized as expected, the firm's shareholders "should benefit directly on the price paid and will not assume Telebras shareholder risk related to use of proceeds."
-- ING Barings also said it was maintaining its buy rating on the firm.
-- Telesp preferred was up 2.94 percent at 245 reais at 1700 local/1900 GMT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
